mapper.insert: INSERT INTO extract_task (document_id, template_id, task_status, task_message, started_at, finished_at, created_by, create_time) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{templateId}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.document_id, t.template_id, t.task_status, t.task_message, t.started_at, t.finished_at, t.created_by, t.create_time FROM extract_task t INNER JOIN extract_document d ON d.id = t.document_id INNER JOIN extract_template et ON et.id = t.template_id WHERE t.created_by = #{userId} ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE extract_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE extract_task SET task_status = #{taskStatus}, task_message = #{taskMessage}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
